entities.name: Query GlmU
observations: 462 aa bacterial bifunctional GlmU-like enzyme; sequence has 56.7% identity and 99.1% coverage to reviewed UniProt A9NH16.
Predicted N-terminal pyrophosphorylase region spans approximately residues 1-228 and C-terminal N-acetyltransferase region approximately residues 250-460.
Likely cytosolic homotrimer based on close reviewed GlmU homologs; Mg2+ binding is annotated in homologs.

entities.name: GlmN-acetyltransferase reaction
observations: Glucosamine 1-phosphate + acetyl-CoA -> N-acetylglucosamine 1-phosphate + CoA + H+; assigned EC 2.3.1.157 and Rhea RHEA:13725 in close reviewed GlmU homologs.

entities.name: GlmU pyrophosphorylase reaction
observations: N-acetylglucosamine 1-phosphate + UTP + H+ -> UDP-N-acetylglucosamine + diphosphate; assigned EC 2.7.7.23 and Rhea RHEA:13509 in close reviewed GlmU homologs.

entities.name: UDP-GlcNAc biosynthesis
observations: The two GlmU reactions are the final sequential steps of bacterial de novo UDP-N-acetylglucosamine biosynthesis, supporting peptidoglycan and lipid A production.
